title: {Syn} GANs Framed Generation as a Two-Model Game
content:
Generative adversarial networks train a generator and discriminator together. The generator tries to synthesize convincing samples while the discriminator tries to spot fakes.

GANs produced sharp images and shaped the generative modeling conversation, even though diffusion and autoregressive models later became dominant in many areas.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
